name: Pingularity Local Internet Monitor
free_limit: MIT-licensed local internet monitoring software with outage history, latency and DNS checks, scheduled speed tests, webhook alerts, Prometheus metrics, and a local dashboard; no software usage quota or expiry published.
watch_out: Runs on your own Linux, macOS, Windows or Docker host; no free VPS, bandwidth, storage or external notification service is included. Speed tests consume internet data; Docker network and NET_RAW permissions need care, and optional Ookla speed tests use external servers.
